quotes.quote: Therefore, we systematically analyzed peripheral blood B and T cell repertoires in a cohort of 34 individuals with HA20, 19 thereof as part of six affected families (table S1), using immunoglobulin heavy chain (IGH) and T cell receptor β chain (TRB) repertoire sequencing (Fig. 1A).

segregation.statement: Three carriers in three generations of one family (index, father, paternal grandmother), all listed among individuals with HA20 in 'affected families'. Affection status per person and any untested or unaffected relatives are not reported.

Therefore, we systematically analyzed peripheral blood B and T cell repertoires in a cohort of 34 individuals with HA20, 19 thereof as part of six affected families (table S1), using immunoglobulin heavy chain (IGH) and T cell receptor β chain (TRB) repertoire sequencing (Fig. 1A).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Canonical splice-acceptor change (-1) at the intron 5 acceptor; protein not predictable from the cDNA alone (batch: p.?), and the paper gives no protein change ('intron 5'). The paper describes the disease as caused by heterozygous germline loss-of-function mutations.

quotes.quote: Haploinsufficiency of A20 (HA20) is a severe childhood-onset inflammatory disease characterized by heterozygous germline loss-of-function (LOF) mutations in TNFAIP3 (1, 2).

concerns: Table-only: the family appears in a supplementary table without clinical descriptions, zygosity or genetic-testing method.
No protein consequence stated (written as 'intron 5'); no RNA study reported.
Affected status is implied by the table title ('patients with HA20') and the text ('affected families'), not stated per person.
